Chapter 126: 0123 The Wind Expansion Pack is Online

Starting from mid-December, the various schools and departments of Peking University began holding their New Year's galas one after another.

The School of Journalism and Communication was the earliest, celebrating the New Year on December 18th.

The Yuanpei Program, on the other hand, held theirs on December 29th.

From the Class of '01 to the Class of '04, the Yuanpei Program had exactly four cohorts, all gathered together for the New Year's gala. There were 477 students in total, with 436 present today; the rest were participating in academic or exchange programs.

Director Zhu, the one who had initially tricked Chen Guiliang into enrolling, was also here.

He was here to present scholarships.

The money had actually already been distributed; today was just for formally awarding the certificates.

One by one, students went up on stage to receive their awards.

The humanities class monitor, Lei Tuo, said to Chen Guiliang, "Starting next year, humanities students in the Yuanpei Program will have advanced math, humanities, and social sciences as required core courses, and they'll also have to take computer science as a general education course."

"What the hell," Chen Guiliang felt a headache coming on.

Not only could he not escape advanced math, but now he had to study computer science too? What was that about?

Lei Tuo said, "The science track is even worse. Their required core courses are advanced math, physics, chemistry, and biology."

Chen Guiliang felt like they were all just guinea pigs. The Yuanpei Program's teaching model was not yet mature and had to be adjusted every year based on the teaching situation.

"Lei Tuo from the '04 humanities class..."

Hearing his name being called, Lei Tuo immediately scurried up to the stage to receive his award.

The scholarships had nothing to do with Chen Guiliang. He was too embarrassed to apply, as he had skipped far too many classes.

Next was the commendation of outstanding students.

"Bai Ruijie from the '01 class won the championship in CCTV's 'Challenge the Host' and has interned as a host at both CCTV and Phoenix Television. Now, student Bai Ruijie has also secured an internship at the 'People's Daily'..."

Chen Guiliang studied this Senior Bai carefully, thinking they could exchange notes in the future.

"Tan Hui from the '01 class..."

A constant stream of students went on stage, mostly juniors and seniors.

"Guo Feng from the '02 class, and Chen Guiliang from the '04 class. The two collaborated to found an internet company, which was successfully selected for the Peking University Science Park incubation program. Their Xiaoneiwang has attracted widespread attention from society..."

Chen Guiliang walked up calmly.

Guo Feng still looked a bit abstract, with who-knows-how-long's worth of stubble on his face, his hair a greasy mess, and a jacket that hadn't been changed since winter began. He seemed oblivious to his disheveled appearance, smiling and waving at his fellow students.

"Crazy Guo!"

"Hahahaha!"

Someone shouted Guo Feng's nickname, and the rest of the students burst into laughter.

Ao Yanchen was also a Yuanpei Program student, but her name wasn't on the incubation agreement, so the university didn't consider her an entrepreneur.

"Student Chen Guiliang, you haven't been enrolled for long, but you've already done quite a lot," Director Zhu said jokingly.

Chen Guiliang said, "I'm ashamed."

He was genuinely ashamed, only hoping he wouldn't fail too many courses.

The seniors on stage receiving awards also looked at Chen Guiliang with curiosity, planning to exchange contact information with him after they got off stage.

Once the awards ceremony was over, the New Year's gala performances officially began.

It started with a street dance. The seniors danced enthusiastically, and their outfits had a bit of a non-mainstream vibe.

Peking University's Yuanpei Program and non-mainstream. That these two terms could be linked... hmm... was quite magical.

What was even more ridiculous was yet to come.

After a few plays, skits, and song and dance performances, the male host (a junior) shouted, "To all the male students in the audience, let's sing 'Single's Love Song' together!"

"Hahaha!"

"Alright!"

Many of the boys in the Yuanpei Program were not in relationships, perhaps due to their personalities, or perhaps due to their heavy academic workload.

"I, who can't grasp love, can only watch it slip away. There are happy people everywhere in the world, so why can't I be one of them..."

The boys sang with great joy. Some even roared at the top of their lungs, making the students next to them laugh out loud.

Chen Guiliang couldn't be a lone wolf, so he hummed along for a few lines, pretending he was still single.

Next, there were interactive games between boys and girls, probably imitating the ones from "Happy Camp."

They were incredibly childish, but everyone had a blast playing.

The gala finally ended at nine in the evening, and everyone headed back together in groups based on their dormitory building numbers.

Chen Guiliang's haul today was pretty good; he got dozens more phone numbers.

Back in the dorm, Min Wenyu flopped directly onto his bed. "Crazy Guo, you finally decided to come back to the dorm. If you hadn't, I was about to report a missing person."

"No time," Guo Feng took off his jacket and rubbed his face.

Guo Feng had been extremely busy lately, not only developing various features but also finding time to continue his computer technology studies.

You think he was wholeheartedly focused on his startup?

The man had never stopped studying; the weight of those 22 courses he registered for was plain to see.

It was just that, aside from computer science, he had now dropped all his other courses.

"I talked with my advisor tonight. He said he can help me transfer to the computer science major," Guo Feng said, rummaging through his clothes to go take a shower.

Jiang Junlai asked, "Not going to study biology with that senior anymore?"

Guo Feng said with great solemnity, "Love is a spiritual resonance between two subjects. They can be both subject and object to each other, but there cannot be a primary-secondary relationship. I've reflected on this recently. Choosing biology for my senior was, in fact, making her the primary and myself the secondary. This deviates from the original intent and true meaning of love."

"Makes sense!" Chen Guiliang chimed in with a grin.

Only after Guo Feng left the dorm with his bucket and a change of clothes did Jiang Junlai say, "I thought he was becoming normal, but it seems he's still a bit..."

"Abstract," Chen Guiliang said.

Jiang Junlai said, "Right, abstract. That word is just too fitting."

Chen Guiliang opened his computer and contacted some netizens through QQ.

These people were all paying players from "Legend of the Abyss," and specifically the ones who had topped up using online banking.

High-quality customers!

Chen Guiliang also left a QQ message for Boss Shi, among others.

But Boss Shi was busy developing "Conquer" and had no time to play "Sanguosha," nor did he have time to shoot the breeze with Chen Guiliang.

The qualification review from UnionPay had not yet been approved; it would certainly have to wait until after the New Year's holiday.

Chen Guiliang had also gone to talk with China Mobile and China Unicom with some minor success, haggling their 70% cut down to 65%. A big company like Shanda could actually negotiate it down to below 60%.

Although the payment channels weren't open yet, they could let players start experiencing the game.

They would run a promotional event starting from New Year's Day.

As long as a player was online for a certain number of minutes each day, they could complete a quest to receive items and silver taels. There were also corresponding rewards for winning a certain number of games each day.

Log in for seven consecutive days, and you could get one month of VIP membership for free.

VIP members could experience the newly released Wind Expansion Pack generals and would receive some items and silver taels upon logging in each day.

Of course, even if one didn't get VIP status during the event, there would still be one random Wind Expansion Pack general in the selection pool.

As for God Guan Yu and God Lü Meng, each use would consume an item. In the future, when it became a paid feature, it would be charged per use, because their abilities were just too overpowered. Free players would also have a chance to experience them, as items to summon the god generals could be obtained through events.

Over at Yuanhuo Animation Club, they were continuously refining and drawing new skins.

In the blink of an eye, it was New Year's Day.

Huang Kai, a freshman animation major at the Communication University of China, returned to his dorm at night and logged into "Sanguosha."

He still didn't know that his destiny had been seized; the game that he was supposed to have invented had appeared two years ahead of schedule.

Huang Kai had been a fan of "Yu-Gi-Oh!" since middle school. Sometime ago, he came across Sanguosha through Xiaoneiwang and instantly became obsessed. He even became a self-appointed promoter, helping to spread the word both online and offline.

As soon as he entered the game, he received a notification.

The previous base set had a total of 25 generals. Ten of them were given upon account registration, while the rest needed to be purchased with silver taels.

Players didn't mind this, as you got silver taels for playing a round, and you could also get them by completing quests.

Moreover, when they finally bought all 25 generals with silver taels, they felt a strange sense of accomplishment.

"This new Yu Ji is really interesting... Wei Yan and Zhang Jiao are pretty good too. Holy crap, God Guan Yu and God Lü Meng are way too overpowered! Good thing you can't just pick them freely; you have to use special items to summon them..."

Huang Kai entered an eight-player room and noticed that two players had flashy skins.

"Where did you guys get your skins?"

"Haha, you can buy treasure chests in the shop with silver taels, and you also get a chest for completing the 'win ten games' daily quest. I got this skin from a treasure chest."
